focuses.trigger: Always unless explicitly excluded; correctness, guideline compliance, and changed-code bugs.
focuses.focus_instruction: Review changed code for concrete correctness defects, project-guideline violations, unsafe assumptions, and regressions. Ignore concerns outside the changed diff.

focuses.trigger: Test files or production behavior changed without matching behavioral coverage.
focuses.focus_instruction: Check behavioral coverage for changed paths, edge cases, failures, async behavior, and contract boundaries. Report only material missing tests tied to changed lines.

focuses.trigger: Error callbacks, retries, fallback branches, rejected promises, or failure propagation changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Inspect error handling, propagation, retries, fallbacks, logging, and user-visible failure behavior. Flag silent or incorrectly swallowed failures introduced by the change.

focuses.trigger: Types, interfaces, classes, schemas, enums, generics, or type boundaries changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Check changed type boundaries for invalid states, unsound assumptions, lost narrowing, incompatible contracts, and invariant leaks.

focuses.trigger: Authentication, authorization, secrets, validation, sanitization, injection, permissions, cryptography, network boundaries, dependencies, or sensitive data changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Audit only changed security boundaries: authentication, authorization, input safety, secrets, injection, SSRF, cryptography, permissions, dependencies, and sensitive data. Report evidence-based high-confidence risks.

focuses.trigger: Algorithms, loops, queries, caching, concurrency, I/O, rendering, allocations, hot paths, or large-data processing changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Check changed hot paths for material complexity, query, I/O, allocation, concurrency, rendering, caching, and large-data regressions. Do not invent benchmarks.

focuses.trigger: Persistence, migrations, transactions, serialization, idempotency, event/state mutation, synchronization, or invariants changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Inspect changed persistence and state transitions for loss, corruption, duplication, stale state, non-atomicity, ordering, retry, and invariant failures.
Review changed UI and rendering for practical WCAG 2.2 AA issues: semantics, keyboard access, focus, labels, contrast, text alternatives, errors, and responsive behavior.

focuses.trigger: Comments, documentation, examples, or user-facing explanatory text changed.
focuses.focus_instruction: Check changed comments and documentation for factual accuracy, useful rationale, completeness, stale references, and misleading examples.

focuses.trigger: Executable, source, or configuration content changed and clarity or maintainability may be affected.
focuses.focus_instruction: Look for behavior-preserving clarity improvements in changed executable, source, and configuration code. Do not propose rewrites without a concrete readability or maintainability benefit.
